newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica creates Exotic Currency unit.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica creates Exotic Currency unit.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said it created a new Exotic Currency Unit in the U.S. to take advantage of market opportunities that can benefit its multinational clients.
Vice President and Chief Trader Jonathan Goldman will head the unit, based in San Francisco, it said.

"We expect emerging markets to be the biggest growth sector in foreign exchange for the next few years," said Executive Vice President Robert McKnew, global head of Foreign Exchange and U.S. Capital Markets for Bank of America.
